review.head: 82a2b85e34499b136c3ec6b53edd0dcd53202b9e
review.summary: I reviewed the whole diff. It replaces the claude-code-action Read-based flow with a direct, tool-free CLI runner that reads the prompt from file-backed stdin, plus the workflow, test and doc changes. I found no substantiated correctness or security defects on the changed lines. The runner's failure paths fail closed: setup, input, runtime, execution and evidence failures each produce a blocked report with a fixed reason category. The input binding checks (repository, PR, head, base, line count) and the validator's exact-model and turn bounds look consistent with the tests. I could not see factory-bounded-process.py, so I could not check the exact keyword arguments the runner passes to it. I also could not check that the CLI accepts `--safe-mode`. Both rest on code outside this diff. I did not run anything, so this is a source review only and no test result is claimed.
